reviews.author: Jason Ham
reviews.text:
Recently opened branch on the first floor on the west side of One Bailey Square
The store is small compared to the number of visitors. It is a store located in a typical building, but it is not a duplex, so the store itself is a small to medium-sized store by Starbucks standards, but the number of visitors is constant, so the tables are always full during the day.

My personal opinion is that Starbucks did a poor job of predicting demand, or that they predicted this level of demand, but due to the delay in signing a contract to open a store at One Bailey Square, I feel like they lost the large store space to other companies, such as financial companies.

Still, like a coffee shop, it occupies the corner space at the end of the building and has full-length windows, so it doesn't feel stuffy, but since it's on the west end, all the windows of the store are tinted.

There are table seats, including 2-person and 4-person seats, in the store, and there is also a power outlet in the single seat at the front. To use the restroom, go out the back door of the store to the left of the desk and use the public restroom on the first floor of One Bailey Square.

reviews.author: Gain Sim
reviews.text:
The atmosphere was exhausted.

Since it is located right in the center of the Han River, the view is probably the best in Seoul.

Rather than simply having a view of the Han River, the size of the restaurant itself is large.
From the entire Han River, you can see the bridge, the water, the city night view, and the sunset.
The interior design makes it stand out even more, and it's really pretty (maybe I went there with low expectations?)

However, since it is located in the exact center of the Han River, the way to get there is unclear.
Let's take the car and have a drink at the wine bar.
If you want to take public transportation, should you wait at the gate for a shuttle bus or take a taxi? It's really vague, but this much
To experience all of this, you have no choice but to overcome it!

One more thing I regret is that the road to get there is difficult.
It's a shame that the names are a bit too grand and the taste is average.
It would have been so much better if there was one ending...

Since it is a large wine importer, the wines are diverse and reasonably priced.
I heard that there are over 100 types of glass.
I think this is a case where they really used their strengths well.

I want to go there with my parents next time!
If you haven't been there, I recommend going once.

reviews.author: Yoon Cheol Chang
reviews.text:
As soon as you enter, it's a pleasant place with a relaxed atmosphere that makes you think you're in Korea. If you sit by the window before the sun sets, the wine will likely pour in. The raw oysters were fresh and delicious, and the other menu items were also good. I don't think there was any need to order oyster gratin. Wine prices are very reasonable. The wine tasting promotion was good and the price was good. There are some original and fun cocktails, but Bloody Mary is basically non-alcoholic, so you have to ask for alcohol when ordering.

When the sun goes down, green lights seem to turn on near the window, but I thought it ruined the atmosphere a bit. There were a lot of people working inside the bar, so I was a little confused about who I should order from, and the alcohol menu provided on a tablet kept taking it away because the tablet wasn't enough, so I had to request a new one several times. It would be nice to have paper alcohol menus other than promotional drinks.

Reservations are very, very difficult, and window seats in particular need to be reserved very early. The text message said it was open until 9 o'clock, but it was actually open until 10 o'clock.

reviews.author: みたらし
reviews.text: It is a tourist attraction on the bridge that spans the Han River in Seoul. This bridge fountain, the world's longest with a length of 1140m, runs at 12:00, 19:30, 20:00, 20:30, and 21:00 during this period. Since I arrived at the square after 20 o'clock (after sunset), I was impressed by the beautiful sight of the fountain shining in a rainbow to the music. It was Sunday and there were many people anyway, so the walking route from the station was full of people. It was a bit difficult to walk for nearly 20 minutes from the nearest station, but I think it was really nice to be able to see this fountain show 🌈 This show is held throughout October.

reviews.author: 首尔上门服务Outcall&Incall
reviews.text: The world's longest bridge fountain lives up to its name! This 1,140-meter-long bridge fountain across the Han River creates a breathtaking spectacle as its rainbow lights change to music. The steps below the bridge are the best viewing spots, but it gets extremely crowded on the weekends, so we recommend visiting on a weekday. Fountain shows run at set times, but may be canceled so check in advance. It's about a 20-minute walk from the subway station, and although the route is a bit complicated, it's well worth the trip. Especially if you visit after sunset, the perfect combination of lights and music will be a highlight of your trip to Seoul. However, check the weather and official notices to avoid disappointment. It is a feast for the eyes that you should never miss during your trip to Korea!

**The best yacht tour with the night view of the Han River!**

Golden Blue Marina's Rainbow Bridge Yacht Tour was a truly unforgettable and special experience. I was able to enjoy the night view of Seoul while riding a yacht along the Han River, and the atmosphere when passing under the Rainbow Bridge was especially fantastic.

The staff were very friendly and the service was attentive, so I was able to enjoy the experience without any inconvenience. The interior of the yacht was neatly maintained, and it was impressive to see a lot of attention to safety. Also, being able to spend a relaxing time with a simple drink made it feel even more special.

I think it's the perfect choice, especially for spending quality time with family, lovers, or friends. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to experience the new charm of Seoul!

reviews.text: This restaurant boasts stunning views of the Han River and is captivating with its unique design that combines a café and yacht marina, as well as dazzling night lighting. The coffee is really great, strong and delicious. However, a fatal drawback is that parking is very difficult. It takes a long time to find a parking space, especially during peak hours. reviews.author: Jason Ham
reviews.text:
It is a support shopping mall directly connected to the Raemian One Bailey Apartment, but like the Raemian Firstage central shopping mall across from Sinbanpo-ro, it is located at one corner of the express bus terminal intersection, so it is expected to become a shopping complex representing not only residents but also the region.

It has 3 underground floors and 5 above-ground floors. The parking lot is on the 2nd and 3rd underground floors, and the rooftop floor is open. It has a rectangular shape from east to west and is centered around a central plaza, giving the impression of buildings A and B, but in reality, they are all connected by a square.

As for transportation between floors, there are elevators for units 1 and 2 on the west side, and units 3 and 4 on the east side, all running from the 3rd basement level to the rooftop, and there is an escalator in front of the east side elevator that runs from the 1st basement level to the 5th floor.

Like a typical large-scale apartment complex, most of the first floor is occupied by a real estate brokerage office, and the first basement floor is home to Hanaro Mart, a laundromat, a hair shop, and a coffee franchise. From the 2nd to the 5th floor, there are hospitals, pharmacies, banks, securities firms, and academies.

As of 2024.02, the underground parking lot is relatively quiet as there are still many vacancies and companies under construction before occupancy. Parking fees are allowed for 30-minute periods and are managed by Amano Korea at 1,000 won per 10 minutes thereafter. There is a Soca Zone on the 3rd basement floor.

Bokmandang is a gomtang restaurant operated by Korean beef omakase Biflique, and is characterized by a clear and deep taste that is carefully boiled in a boiler every day in the store.
Only No. 7 and No. 8 Korean beef is used, and the soup tastes good, so it is highly recommended for children and women.
The menu is simple with gomtang and hand dumplings, but it is sufficient along with delicious radish radish kimchi and kimchi.

The soup was served with seasoning and was a bit salty, but it was okay to eat with rice, and it was served as a side dish, making it feel like I was at a real soup and rice restaurant. And the radish radish kimchi served in a brass bowl is excellent. The store opens at 11 a.m., but when I visited at 11:35, there were only 2 seats left, so I went in and there was a wait right away. I recommend eating it as a special rather than regular. This is the first tier of gomtang in Bangbae-dong.

reviews.author: Ji Heon Ahn
reviews.text: This is a rib restaurant located between Bangbae Station and Naebang Station. I visited around 11:30 a.m. on a weekday, and it was fully booked, so there were so many people that I had to wait for about 10 minutes. While contemplating between galbitang and kimchi stew, I ordered galbitang and it tasted decent. The broth was rich and flavorful, and the ribs were meaty but not very large. ㅁㅇㄷㅅ located in Naebang Station also serves galbitang, and although the galbitang itself is similar, the long ribs were better because they came with pot rice. The rice was shiny and delicious. The side dishes are plentiful and the staff is quick to respond. However, the high-pitched voices of the employees checking each other were a bit annoying, the store was too crowded, and I sat outside, but my chair was hit a couple of times by the employees pulling out the cards, so it wasn't a very good dining experience. The galbitang itself is excellent, so I recommend visiting if you're looking for hot soup.

reviews.author: Bb
reviews.text: This is a pork rib restaurant worth visiting. The raw pork ribs are clean without any odor, and the seasoning has a luxurious, subtle scent. Not only the main meat but also the sides are perfect! All side dishes are more than basic. I especially hope you try the seasoned crab and deodeok. Blue crabs take on a new flavor when grilled over an open fire. I really recommend Hamheung for cold noodles. This is properly made cold noodles, not the flavor of boiled cold noodles in a roughly packaged package. The broth is really refreshing and clean. I really fell in love with the sense of giving ice cream at the end^^

reviews.author: Shinnalchi
reviews.text:
It's a new pork rib restaurant that opened in Bangbae-dong.
What is this? It was already full of people.

This is a place that sells raw Korean pork ribs.
It's a direct grilling system, so it's okay if you can't grill the ribs.
A craftsman with long experience
You can cut it tightly and bake it for easy eating!

Raw ribs are silky soft and juicy in your mouth.
The ‘pogeuljang’ you eat here is a real steal!
It’s soybean paste that enhances the flavor of any meat!

The basis of pork ribs is the seasoning (for those who don't, there's nothing you can do)
First fired at 600℃ in a dedicated oven made of natural volcanic stone,
It’s okay to just slightly cook it at your seat!
It's moderately sweet and goes well with any side dish.
Especially if you eat it with gondre pot rice? It's over.

Soybean paste stew, water cold noodles, and bibim cold noodles were all good.
And, depending on the number of people, it's not just ice cream.
Even the sense of giving excellence....

This rib restaurant is already popular with families and adult gatherings in Bangbae-dong.
I highly recommend going before it gets more famous.

reviews.author: Sunyoung Park
reviews.text: It's the best pork ribs I've had recently. It's good value for money and the side dishes are clean and delicious.

reviews.author: yongsuk moon
reviews.text:
So, the food? Absolutely delicious! And the staff? Just nice!! I live righ front of and I'd been following them on Instagram since before they even opened. My 5yr old son was so excited, so we finally went.
Since it's only their third day and it was peak time, it was a little chaotic. You could tell they were really trying to get their rhythm down, which was good to see, but honestly, the whole experience—from being seated to getting our food—felt pretty amateurish ㅠㅠ I'm sure they'll get better with time. The pre-grilled meat was fantastic! But the side dishes?? they were tasty, but the variety was a letdown lol My kids are 3 and 5, and there was the only one thing they could just eat. They didn't even have kids' dish, spoons and forks yet lol I know that not many BBQ restaurants do lettuce wraps anymore and they're using a salad instead, but the bowl was tiny, lol. I also really wish they'd change the dressing also.
Here's the scary part, they had cups and dishes in the hallway, and my older son accidentally knocked one over. My little one fell, but thankfully she was okay, just a little piece of glass on her skin.
It just didn't feel like it was run by the Myeongin Deungsim group; it felt more like someone who first time opened a BBQ restaurant
I know they sold out all meats and are doing so well, which is great, but the messy atmosphere, the limited side dishes, the service, and the managing all need to get more professional. Since it's so close to my home, I'll come back, so I hope they get it all change or improve soon!
Oh, and because I mentioned following on Instagram, they gave us a free steamed egg! How cool is that? ^^ one more,,, Manager said "We will give a free steamed egg becouse you aee the our Instagram followers" then bring it after 10 min? It was sooo amateurish. A professional would bring the steamed egg to the table and then say, 'Here's today"s service dish for you thanks for the following Instagram.'"

Food? It's delicious! Serving? You are so kind!! Yes! Since it was in front of my house, I had been following it on Instagram even before construction, and my 5-year-old son made sure to go there when it opened. Maybe it's because it's only the 3rd day of opening, maybe it's because it's peak time, but it was nice to see them trying to keep pace, but everything from the guidance to the serving had a very beginner feel ㅠㅠ It'll get better with time, right?^^ The meat preparation was really good, the side dishes were delicious, but the composition was ㅠㅠ There was something for the kids to eat, but other than that, there was no side dish they could use (the kids are 3 and 5 years old)... They haven't purchased spoons and forks for the kids yet. ㅠㅠ I understand why they replace it with salad because there aren't many restaurants that serve ssam, but the bowl is too small. If you change the salad dressing as well... There were cups and bowls placed in the aisle, and the older child was careless and broke the cup, causing the younger child to fall, but luckily he got away with only a few glass shards.  Doesn't it feel like you're running a meat restaurant for the first time, rather than at a famous sirloin restaurant? It would be nice to have a good time to congratulate the business as we ran out of ingredients, but the cluttered atmosphere and cold composition needed improvement in service quality and professional management. I think I'll be going there often since it's in front of my house, so I hope it improves quickly. ah! I was talking about Instagram, and they gave me a steamed egg service ^^ Also, rather than saying I'll give you a steamed egg service and then bringing it back 10 minutes later, how much of a surprise would it be if you looked at my Instagram and said I'd give you a service? I'm so new haha
I too am a beginner because the review is too long haha
